description: Turns a one-pass pulse into a held level: the enable sets it and Reset clears it. The output stays active until Reset wins.

activation.text: Samples the enable and Reset on every pass; the enable sets the held state, Reset clears it even when the enable is off.

enable.description: Sets the held state when it is true. Connect a Set signal to the enable; the latch keeps its output active until Reset.

eno.description: The held level: true after the enable sets it, until Reset clears it.

inputs.description: Clears the held state, even when the enable is off. Optional: an unwired Reset reads as false.

fields.description: Which signal wins when the enable and Reset are both true.

options.description: When the enable and Reset are both true the output is set.
When the enable and Reset are both true the output is reset.
